name: Zytale
summary: Adaptive Surface 0.9.3 for Hytale 0.6.8: one creative smoothing block copies the clicked block's preloaded material, persists native shape/material states, and loads a selective per-world HD texture pack. User reported the result near-perfect. Full automated client visual and click tracing were not performed.
constraints: Do not use the Computer Use skill for this project; user explicitly prohibited it
Do not mutate saved chunks while preparing textures
No runtime asset registration or world refresh for material changes
Only one item in creative inventory; no command
Unknown material becomes active at a subsequent restart
Compatibility with future Hytale versions requires validation
10 million active HD pixels is a project safety budget, not an established Hytale limit
decisions: Keep full material catalogue dormant inside JAR; WorldMaterialScanner selects saved-world block IDs, WorldPatch writes ZAS_ActivePack.zip
Installer enables generated pack ID ZytaleGenerated:AdaptiveSurfaceWorld in save config and backs up prior config/JAR/ZIP
Use native-density atlas for fallback legacy block IDs; preserve their save compatibility
Resolve clicked donor from matching placement interaction sync data before falling back to current-view raycast
Persist material while topology refresh changes only shape
Retain failure and solution-version lineage in EXP-000001
validation_notes: 0.9.3 offline Gradle build and asset validation passed
Previous client log verified selective pack active, with 56 appearances and 921 aliases
Final 0.9.3 click behavior is user feedback, without instrumented client trace
Dedicated-server full-world tests were hindered by unrelated native QUIC and shutdown failures
